purpose: Provide a coherent, revisable visual baseline for clear learning tasks and recognizable knowledge space. Product concepts stay in their owners; execution and review policy stay in spec/machine-acceptance.json. Design references help implementation, and do not prescribe an artifact-first workflow or prove product quality.
authority_note: Nothing here can override spec/product-core.json, spec/interactions.json, spec/knowledge-map.json, spec/card-system.json, spec/action-surface.json, or spec/membership.json. When this file disagrees with an owner listed in spec/authority-map.json, the owner wins and this file is edited to match.

product_truth.note: Protect product comprehension: one current learning task, distinct meaningful interactions, honest self-assessment and judgement, stable library identity, and spatial ownership. Fonts, shapes, exact colors, layout and design-document order are implementation choices.

user_visible_metadata_leakage_is_blocker.claim: Any design artifact or implementation mapping that exposes agent, harness, spec, validator, metadata, runtime, mock, prototype, seed, fixture, debug, dev, raw exception, API route, repo path, or TODO language in user-visible UI is blocked and must be quarantined before implementation.

single_card_flow_is_operable_focused_flo.claim: Single-card flow means a focused current-card task with an identifiable primary action, bounded secondary actions, feedback, recovery, and Learning to Space continuity. It must not be implemented as a dense one-screen poster or dashboard that the learner cannot operate.

library_identity_is_visually_distinct.claim: Each CET library in spec/knowledge-map.json must be visually identifiable by a stable, learnable identity color so that the user always knows which library they are currently in.
library_identity_is_visually_distinct.mapping_stability: Once published to users, a library's assigned hue family must not be reassigned to another library in subsequent releases. The specific hex is implementation; the hue family (indigo / coral / mint / violet / cyan / rose / amber) becomes mnemonic and is therefore sticky.

law_of_one_current_library.claim: The current library and primary learning action must be easy to recognize. Keep library identity, interaction feedback and navigation roles coherent; other library markers may appear when comparing or browsing space. No fixed percentage of colored area is a product requirement.

self_assess_feedback_scoped_to_flip.claim: Flip uses the two light self-assess states confident / review (有把握 / 需要复习), as defined by spec/interactions.json#flip.scoring_mode=light_self_assess. Auto-scored multiple_choice, lock, elimination and swipe show their actual judgement without another mastery self-assessment. Feedback must distinguish confidence from correctness and avoid punitive framing; exact colors and control shapes are revisable defaults.

map_must_visualize_hierarchy.claim: The knowledge map surface must render the library → group → box → card hierarchy as visible spatial structure, not a flat list. This is the physical-space commitment from AP-02.

interaction_silhouettes_are_distinguisha.claim: The five core interactions (flip / multiple_choice / lock / elimination / swipe) must expose their distinct learning actions and feedback clearly. A shared frame is acceptable when the actual affordances are understandable. Blurred silhouettes are an optional design diagnostic, not an acceptance condition.

implementation_hypothesis.note: Shared defaults keep one product language. Models may revise layout, typography, materials and feedback presentation to improve the task, with proportionate observation of the result. No prior failure, separate design approval, fixed candidate count or source-code shape is required. Keep related active defaults consistent when they change.

self_assess_hex_defaults._note: Two levels, not four. 'review' is a warm amber (not red): it means '回来再看一次', not '错了/惩罚'.

palette.usage_constraint: Use labels, shape and context to distinguish library identity from confidence or correctness. Shared hues in different roles must not create an ambiguous judgement or require color perception alone.

display.family: platform system font; web system-ui with PingFang SC and Microsoft YaHei fallbacks
display.letter_spacing: natural spacing; tighten only large display headings

body_en.family: platform system font; web system-ui with PingFang SC and Microsoft YaHei fallbacks

body_cn.family: platform system font; web system-ui with PingFang SC and Microsoft YaHei fallbacks

mono.family: platform system font; web system-ui with PingFang SC and Microsoft YaHei fallbacks
mono.usage: tabular numerals only; explanatory text uses the normal body font

typography.italic_accent_policy: Italic variant is used as editorial emphasis (lede-style), not as decoration. At most one italic run per hierarchy level.

glass_and_surfaces.edge_rim: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08) outer on night, 1px rgba(11,11,20,0.05) outer on day
glass_and_surfaces.shadow_policy: One restrained shadow for floating navigation or authentication. Opaque white paper and softly tinted chapter banners provide depth; no nested elevated paragraphs.

motion.reduce_motion_fallback: Keep final content and every action available; disable spatial travel.

device_frames.rationale: Reference dimensions support comparison only. Real safe areas, content, window size and accessibility text scaling govern each platform.

component_vocabulary_rules: Scale long prompts as reading text and switch long options to one column based on text pressure, available width and text scale; never shorten imported material to fit.
Use one help entry with independent hint and peek reveals; opening the entry alone does not count as assistance. Place available audio near the task before answer options without autoplay.
Favorites and pending review filter accessible cards without changing ownership or the active Learning selection. Distinguish daily counts, current group progress and verified cumulative coverage.
Use one reading paper for the current task; identity is a quiet address and a small current-library accent.
Use a focused learning scene with quiet Exit and Space actions; restore the normal four-route shell outside study. Keep navigation separate from answering and preserve accessible touch areas.

Show a compact confirmed-round count with a thin step line and a quiet current-catalog coverage count. Distinguish confirmed practice attempts from unique cards; progress must not become a dominant object.
Use spacing and a small number of dividers to distinguish material, action, help and result; do not wrap each paragraph.

taste_axes._note: Directions for review, not pass claims. Actual reading, action meaning and spatial comprehension decide the quality of a design.

restraint_vs_expression.test: Every accent or motion helps recognition, hierarchy, continuity or feedback. Keep decorative elements quiet and out of the reading area.

material_vs_flat.test: The learner can distinguish the current paper, a box and the surface beneath them. An opaque paper is valid; blur, grain and decorative atmosphere are optional.

editorial_vs_marketing.test: No promotional language, no exclamation marks in chrome, no 'limited time' ribbons. Typography carries authority the way a book does, not the way a landing page does.

quiet_vs_loud.test: Max one strong accent per screen (Law of One). Max one motion loop visible at a time. No competing animations.

geometric_vs_organic.test: Use a consistent readable sans typography and icon language. Shapes follow the card, sentence or box they represent.

sparse_vs_dense.test: Keep the task and next action findable. Preserve all reading material and allow purposeful scrolling; do not inflate short content to fill a quota.

interaction_silhouettes._note: Current interaction examples. Preserve the learning action and scoring semantics; layout may adapt to content, platform, accessibility or an improved design. These shapes are neither snapshot requirements nor a blurred-screen gate.

flip.shape: One paper carrying the prompt, a hidden back with genuinely additional content, then exactly two self-assess choices. No fixed percentage of empty stage.

multiple_choice.shape: Question followed by four comparable options; preserve 2x2 where readable and stack under content or accessibility pressure.

lock.shape: A forming sentence above ordered lock rows; completing the last correct row reveals the result without another confirmation.

elimination.shape: Selectable spans in the original passage become struck and reversible; the surviving sentence is legible. If exact non-overlapping spans cannot be mapped, preserve the passage with an explicit candidate set.

swipe.shape: deck of stacked cards with directional trail hints (left/right); exactly one card visible on top; horizontal motion is the primary affordance.

large_text_on_surface.standard: WCAG AA large (≥24px regular or ≥19px bold)

contrast_floor._note: Day and night both. When a chip/button uses library identity at low alpha, the text color inside must still clear the floor against the computed background, not against the base surface.

design_iteration.baseline_use: Start from the relevant current screen or design reference. Models may explore and update implementation and baseline in one task; a separate accepted artifact is optional.
design_iteration.record: Use the ordinary PR validation section for the task exercised, observations and relevant unverified scope. Refer to a design or capture when it explains the change; no mandatory AP/Q answers or historical artifact allowlist.
design_iteration.evidence_boundary: A document, URL, screenshot, source pattern or author claim alone cannot prove that the user can complete the task. Validation of a PR declaration is not UX acceptance.

review_prompts._note: Optional prompts selected for the current risk. Do not answer every question mechanically or create a new record for each prompt.
questions: Can the learner identify the current task, operate it, understand the feedback and continue?
Does the feedback explain something useful without overstating completion, confidence or mastery?
Are reading material and actions usable at the affected screen size, text size and keyboard state?
Does space communicate current location, ownership and a clear way back to learning?
Is the visual hierarchy coherent, with decoration and navigation supporting the learning task?
